title: Menkoe Happy Ghast and Ghastling
description: A resource pack that turns the happy ghast and ghastling into a player named Menkoe.
body:
This resource pack changes the Happy Ghast into Menkoe from Synergy!

Perfect for having a Menkoe wherever you go.
You can even ride your Menkoe!

Requirements:
1.21.11

This MenkoePack™️ has the stamp of approval from Menkoe.

I allow Vira to use this pack in theirs.
